$description: Fictional icon grammar for the svg lint tests. Values follow Lucide's published guide (lucide.dev/guide/design/icon-design-guide): 24 canvas, 1 px padding, 2 px stroke, round caps and joins, corner radius 2 (or 1 for small shapes).

padding.$description: minimum inset of ink, stroke included

linejoin.$description: DTCG has no line-join type; svg lint reads this string

gap.$description: recorded for designers; not checked by svg lint
